Precondition: Config Tool open at Item Master BOMs section for an assembled item
Step: Create a BOM and add component lines
Expected Result: BOM is created with parent item, version number, and effective date; each line specifies child item, quantity per parent, UOM, and sort order

Precondition: A draft BOM with multiple lines
Step: Reorder lines using the up/down arrow buttons
Expected Result: Line sort order changes via arrows (no drag-and-drop); order persists on save

Step: Revise the BOM (create new version) and publish it
Expected Result: A new version is created with a new EffectiveFrom; the prior version is soft-deleted (DeprecatedAt set) but remains queryable for historical traceability

Precondition: A part with a superseded BOM version
Step: Inspect an old production/LOT record that used the superseded version
Expected Result: Production records FK to the BOM version active at time of manufacture; the historical version is preserved and resolvable

Precondition: A BOM open in the editor
Expected Result: BOM is single-level (one parent -> child lines); no nested/multi-level explosion is authored in the editor

Precondition: Config Tool open at Item Master Routes section for a manufactured item
Expected Result: Route is created with item, version number, name, and effective date; soft-delete supported
Each step references an operation template, carries a sequence number and a required flag

Precondition: A draft route with multiple steps
Step: Reorder steps using the up/down arrow buttons
Expected Result: Step sequence changes via arrows and renumbers; order persists on save

Precondition: A route step open in the editor
Step: Inspect what a route step references
Expected Result: Step references an operation template (operation role) only; there is no machine or location field — the operator picks an eligible machine at runtime

Step: Revise the route (create new version) and publish it
Expected Result: A new version is created; the prior version is retained and production records FK to the version active at execution time

Step: Insert an additional operation and delete an operation within the route
Expected Result: Operations can be inserted and removed within the route, supporting parts that skip steps or need extra operations
